teachingQuestion: How does a security learning program demonstrate improvement rather than attendance?
focalInsight: Risk and audience determine the intervention; behavior evidence and changing threats determine the next iteration.
title: Security learning as a behavior-improvement loop
caption: Completion may be one signal, but the loop measures whether the intended decision or reporting behavior improved.

nodes.label: Risk and audience
nodes.detail: Who must make which safer decision?

nodes.label: Measure behavior
nodes.detail: Reporting, skill, error reduction, process use

altSummary: A five-stage loop connects risk and audience, learning intervention, practical enablement, behavior measurement, and feedback from incidents or trends.
textFallback: Identify the risk, audience, and desired safe decision. Choose awareness, education, training, or champion support that matches the need. Give people realistic practice and an easy process to follow or report through. Measure relevant behavior in context. Use incidents, trends, feedback, and emerging technology to refresh the risk and intervention.
